sentences.text: Two conditions, peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A (Zellweger) and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5, are both recorded as caused by the gene PEX5 [e_900224c13836] [e_2f08386094bb].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_900224c13836] [e_2f08386094bb].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.9, the lower of the two gene links [e_e7aec8de5621].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_e7aec8de5621].

The Zellweger form has two recorded features, stippled calcification of cartilage and abnormal development of the liver bile ducts, each curated at a low confidence of 0.5 [e_054c701de9cd] [e_ce5735336811].
The rhizomelic condition has one recruiting registry listed on ClinicalTrials.gov [e_e51d1ba0bb5a].
These edges do not show how the two conditions compare in symptoms, and they show no treatments [e_e7aec8de5621] [e_e51d1ba0bb5a].
